P: Piyāyati，[denom．fr．piya1] to hold dear，to like，to be fond of （Acc．），to be devoted to S．I，210； J．I，156； II，246； VI，5； VbhA．108 （in etym．of pitā，q．v．）； DhA．IV，125； SnA 78； VvA．349； PvA．71．-- pp．piyāyita．Note．A ppr．piyaṁ is found at SnA 169 for Sn．94 adj．piya，and is expld by pīyamāna tussamāna modamāna．（Page 460）
I: piyāyati：To be fond of，to be devoted to，honour

DOP: piyāyati pr. 3 sg. ( a ) piyāyanta, mfn. , Pj II 78, 20 (naṃ ure vilittacandanaṃ viya … ~anto parihari); — neg. appiyāyanta, mfn. , Ja V 114, 26´ (kalyāṇakammaṃ dussanto appiyāyanto aṭṭiyanto); — atipiyāyanta, mfn. , Mhv 33:3; ( b ) piyāyamāna, mfn. , Ja II 133, 14 ; V 75, 27 (sakkheyyātha nu kho tumhe ete ~amānā viya taṃ kāraṇaṃ pucchitun ti); Sv 937, 14 ; — aor. 3 pl. piyāyiṃsu, Ja IV 359, 13´ ; — absol. piyāyitvā, Ja III 384, 11 ; Mp III 41, 4 ; — pp piyāyita , mfn. , loved; held dear; Sn 807 (evaṃ pi ~aṃ janaṃ petaṃ kālakataṃ na passati); Ja III 390, 7´ ; VI 115, 19´ (manussehi ~assa varabhaṇḍassa thenakā); — piyāyito in Ee at D III 168, 23* : read bahujanapiyāyito with Be, Ce; — fpp piyāyitabba, mfn. , Ud-a 119, 20 (piyāyitabbaṭṭhena piyo); 260, 4 (sā amhākaṃ cakkhu viya jīvitaṃ viya ca piyāyitabbā); Th-a I 100, 31 (piyāyitabbatāya); Thī-a 206, 35 (kena nāma kāraṇena tuyhaṃ samaṇā piyāyitabbā jātā ti); — piyāyitabbatara, mfn. , compar. , Ud-a 273, 8 (koci añño attanā piyāyitabbataro).
